your_book:
Thursday was a tale of two sectors for Jaleel's book. NVIDIA surged +8.74% — the single biggest contributor on the day — apparently shrugging off pre-earnings jitters that the headline warned about, with the market clearly liking what it heard around the Q2 report. Adobe (+5.73%) and SAP (+4.48%) both caught a lift from a B of A price-target sweep across software names, where the analyst cited easing AI-disruption fears and re-rated valuations upward. Broadcom added +4.49% on similar semiconductor/AI tailwinds. Those four names did the heavy lifting and kept the overall book in positive territory despite a rough day for healthcare and consumer names.

The drag side was meaningful: Zoetis fell -3.22% and Boston Scientific -3.11%, both carrying elevated risk flags (BSX's guidance was slashed to 7–8.5% growth and the flag notes flat guidance through Q3). Abbott dropped -2.20%, extending a soft stretch on the back of a trimmed EPS outlook. AutoZone slipped -2.22% with no clear catalyst provided. Collectively, these four names represent roughly 34% of the book by weight, so the pressure was real even if NVIDIA's surge offset much of it. Rocket Lab bounced +2.04% but remains -13.8% in the hole and carries an AVOID verdict — price and thesis are clearly not converging.

The drift to watch: BSX and ZTS together sit near 19% of the book, both underwater and both rated STRONG BUY — the system is leaning into names the market is actively repricing lower. LULU is also -10.1% with a guidance-cut flag and an earnings print due September 3. That's the nearest hard date on the calendar. ADBE's September 10 report will test whether today's B of A bump holds or the AI-moat narrative reasserts itself.

attention.headline: Nearly 9% weight, -4.8% underwater, guidance slashed — flat growth flagged through Q3
attention.note: With FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5% and management explicitly guiding flat through Q3, the STRONG BUY verdict needs to be reconciled against a deteriorating fundamental picture before the October 28 print.

attention.headline: Earnings September 3 — guidance-cut flag live, Americas comps -5% for fifth straight quarter
attention.note: The risk flag is elevated, the position is -10.1% in the red, and the next catalyst is less than a week away; a decision on sizing ahead of that print is overdue.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name, -13.8% unrealized loss, +2.04% bounce changes nothing structurally
attention.note: Today's pop on vague 'whale activity' headlines does not address the AVOID verdict or the deepening loss — the thesis gap here is the widest in the book and warrants a hard exit review.

attention.headline: B of A lift today, but AI-moat narrative and CFO exit unresolved ahead of September 10 earnings
attention.note: The risk flag notes that narrative — not numbers — is driving the stock, and today's gain is sentiment-driven; September 10 will either validate the re-rating or snap it back hard.
